qf0a_tests: software/pipeline implementation of a known relational-time construction
internal consistency against an exact analytic identity
constructibility under frozen provenance and evidence contracts
qf0a_does_not_test: interacting clock dynamics in the Smith-Ahmadi sense
absence of external time in nature
amendments.pass_semantics: pipeline qualification / constructibility evidence only; never Foundation supporting evidence for nature

amendments.dependency_clarification: QF-0A PASS is a pipeline-qualification prerequisite only, not scientific evidence supporting QF-0D.
